decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on speed and aggression, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also has a strong control element with cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Expressive Iteration and Consider help to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage. The deck also includes a mix of targeted removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fiery Islet to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach alongside spells like Consider, Lightning Bolt, and Counterspell to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder help to fill up the graveyard, while cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional value and pressure. The deck focuses on efficient card selection and graveyard recursion to consistently execute its game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of control and aggression, this deck aims to outmaneuver and outpace its opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand while disrupting their game plan with powerful removal spells and disruptive creatures. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers and card advantage engines to grind out games and generate incremental advantage. The inclusion of powerful finishers such as Elesh Norn and Omnath allows the deck to close out games quickly once it has stabilized the board. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana necessary for casting the deck's powerful spells.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and utilize cards like Blood Moon to hinder the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck looks to quickly close out the game through a combination of disruption, aggression, and efficient card choices.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. It utilizes fast mana fixing with Bloodstained Mire and Blood Crypt, along with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent quickly. The deck also incorporates disruptive elements like Seasoned Pyromancer and Terminate to control the board. With a mix of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, usually Inkmoth Nexus or Ornithopter, and swinging for lethal infect damage in just a few turns. The key strategy involves efficiently tutoring for equipment cards with Steelshaper's Gift and Stoneforge Mystic, while leveraging the card draw and cost reduction abilities of Puresteel Paladin. Sigarda's Aid allows you to flash in equipment at instant speed, catching opponents off guard. Urza's Saga helps find the necessary artifacts while providing additional utility. The deck aims to win before opponents can mount a defense.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Combo - Living End deck is to cycle through your deck quickly, utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill your graveyard. With cards like Violent Outburst and Living End, you can then bring back powerful creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Oliphaunt to overwhelm your opponent. By using cards like Force of Negation to protect your combos and Shardless Agent to cascade into more powerful spells, you can quickly set up a board state that is difficult for your opponent to deal with.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game using a variety of spells and abilities to dominate the board while preventing the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. By utilizing powerful control cards like Counterspell, Wrenn and Six, and Teferi, Time Raveler, along with sweepers like Supreme Verdict and removal spells like Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to maintain control and dictate the pace of the game. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude, as well as a versatile land base, provides additional tools to secure victory through control.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through counterspells, removal, and planeswalkers while also generating value through card draw and recursion. It aims to stabilize the board with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also utilizes powerful utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Leyline Binding to further control the game. The combination of removal, planeswalkers, and threats allows the deck to outvalue opponents and ultimately control the game to victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards, disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Grief and Force of Negation, and ultimately cascade into Living End to board wipe and reanimate powerful creatures like Oliphaunt and Generous Ent. By utilizing cards that allow for free or efficient cycling, along with cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and swing the game in its favor.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck includes cards that allow for searching and drawing additional goblin creatures, such as Goblin Matron and Goblin Ringleader. It also includes cards like Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker to create copies of powerful goblins. The deck includes various lands that support the goblin theme, as well as cards that provide additional benefits or disruption, like Munitions Expert and Sling-Gang Lieutenant. Overall, the deck aims to utilize goblin synergy and aggression to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with fast creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures and maintain board presence. By combining disruption and aggression, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory before they can stabilize.

The key strategy of this deck revolves around efficiently ramping up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, while controlling the board with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending. The ultimate goal is to cast Scapeshift, sacrificing lands to search your deck for more Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and mountains to deal massive damage to your opponent. Bring to Light allows for flexibility in searching for key spells, and Omnath, Locus of Creation provides additional value with landfall triggers. This deck aims to control the game tempo until it can combo off and win.

This deck is focused on quickly dealing direct damage to the opponent with burn spells and efficient aggressive creatures. The deck aims to be fast and relentless, applying pressure early on and finishing off the opponent before they can stabilize. Cards like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear provide early aggression, while spells like Lava Spike and Lightning Bolt help finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack also helps to prevent the opponent from gaining life or utilizing life gain effects. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with consistent, fast damage.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through creatures to build up a board, then using spells to cascade into the powerful card Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. This combo can overwhelm opponents with big creatures and disrupt their game plan, while also having counterspells and disruption to protect the combo. The deck aims to control the game until it can execute its game-winning combo, utilizing the cascade mechanic and creature cycling to its advantage.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes Wrenn and Six for card advantage and mana ramping, along with Leyline Binding for additional control. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bitter Reunion offers additional versatility and ways to manipulate the board state. Overall, this deck relies on creative combos and resource management to outmaneuver opponents in the Modern format.
